title: Aerated Adventurous Filipino Bread Halo Halo
description: A unique Filipino dessert featuring stale bread, roasted and aerated to perfection, served in a lotus leaf wrap with a variety of sweet ingredients, this halal-friendly dish is a twist on the classic halo halo, it is made with fry grind rice khao khuah and other adventurous ingredients
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the stale bread into small cubes and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
Allow the bread to cool, then grind it into fine crumbs using a food processor.
Mix the ground bread with the fried and ground rice khao khuah.
In a large bowl, combine the coconut milk, sugar, and water, and stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the roasted bread and rice mixture to the coconut milk mixture and stir well.
Add the jackfruit, kaong, and nata de coco to the mixture and stir gently.
Spoon the mixture into the lotus leaves, making sure to fill them to the brim.
Fold the lotus leaves to form a bundle and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Serve the Aerated Adventurous Filipino Bread Halo Halo chilled, garnished with additional ingredients if desired.
